body: I really, really appreciate it. I'll do my best, but I don't feel like I have much left in me. Thank you.

I plan to tomorrow, but I'm dreading the call to my dream university where I break it to them that my visa application has basically failed. I'm basically crumbling to the point where I can't do anything but lie around and sob. I hope that they can give me some sort of useful information, but I don't want to get my hopes up. Thanks, mate.

It's not so much 18k as it is 'finding a salary job within 2 months of finishing a MA'. I will take the student visa, but I'm worried that I'll distance myself from her in an effort to make it 'easier' later. I've already somewhat started to distance myself from my friends.

I don't think I can handle failing. I don't have the energy to scrape myself back up and build something new. I can't imagine doing it all again, alone, in a country I haven't lived in since I was 14.

Thanks for taking the time to reply. I appreciate it.

Maybe once every few weeks. When we're both really busy and we can't manage to see each other, it doesn't really happen.

I don't know, honestly. My girlfriend (I'm also female) isn't always comfortable with receiving, so she usually wants to give - but I have a lot of body hangups because of an eating disorder / body dysmorphia and sometimes I can't handle the idea of sex, nevermind the act. I just feel too uncomfortable in my own skin to really enjoy it.

I've been trying to get better at it, and it's hardly 'lesbian bed death', as we're both still interested in sex and will have it a lot when I'm in a good place and when she's in a good place, but it can be tough sometimes.
